$comment: Expected canonical post-migration state for docs/save_compat/manifest.json's e1-unit-location-knowledge baseline's lua-unit-ai-v4 fixture (issue #915). The tracked .bin is a REAL v4-shaped unit_ai payload -- typed {__ref='location_instance', page, id, x, y} memories plus the v2/v3 wrapped fields and __owner -- produced by the PRODUCTION encoder itself (scripts/unit_ai_save_refs.lua's wrapAiState, then scripts/lib/data_codec.lua's M.encode) inside a real HsLua VM, not a hand-rolled table matching what the encoder is believed to emit. It exists because the e1 SESSION fixture's canonical summary is Lua-opaque by construction (SessionSnapshot carries no Lua state), so save_compat_audit alone cannot notice this typed memory being dropped or mis-encoded; Test.Headless.Lua.SaveModules's 'tracked v1 fixtures from disk' describe block drives these bytes through the real saveModules.prepareLoad/applyAll round trip and asserts exactly the values below. The two memories deliberately share instance id 1 on DIFFERENT pages -- the aliasing case a page-blind reference would get wrong.
